togething.description: Developed and maintained a social platform focused on goal setting, positive habits, and user engagement.

responsibilities.0: Developed and enhanced mobile features using React Native and TypeScript.
responsibilities.1: Worked with GraphQL, React Query, and state management solutions including Redux Toolkit, Zustand, and Valtio.
responsibilities.2: Implemented real-time communication and data synchronization using SignalR.
responsibilities.3: Maintained in-app purchases and subscription flows for Android and iOS.
responsibilities.4: Improved media loading, image caching, and recovery of expired media URLs.
responsibilities.5: Investigated production crashes, application startup issues, and performance bottlenecks.
responsibilities.6: Collaborated with backend and product teams to deliver new features.
responsibilities.7: Used AI coding agents to support implementation, debugging, refactoring, testing, and documentation.

togething.projectNote: Project: Togething – social & habit-building platform. Available on the App Store and Google Play.

responsibilities.2: Built reusable UI components based on custom design specifications.
responsibilities.3: Integrated REST and GraphQL APIs and implemented client-side data management.
responsibilities.4: Worked with JavaScript-to-native communication and native mobile integrations.
responsibilities.5: Optimized rendering, application startup, and resource consumption.
responsibilities.6: Contributed to technical reviews, architecture decisions, and debugging.
responsibilities.7: Supported junior developers and collaborated with backend, design, and product teams.
responsibilities.8: Used AI-assisted development tools for implementation, code analysis, debugging, and documentation.

apsy.projectNote: Projects include Common Time, MVP, Alba Education, BitcoinBachelors, Drive & Detours, and related mobile products.
